description_en: Updates the information of a logical database
name: EditLogicDatabase

parameters.help_en:
To update the alias of the logical database, enter a new alias.
If you do not need to update the alias, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141872.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211425.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
如果需要修改逻辑库别名，请填入新的逻辑库别名。
如果不需要修改逻辑库别名，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141872.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211425.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: alias

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: logic_db_id

parameters.help_en: The physical databases that correspond to the logical database
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库对应的所有物理库
parameters.name: database_ids

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
